status: Translation anchor using measured tilted finger links; independent placement validation required.

translation_fit.limitation: Single-pose anchor residual is a training residual, not independent accuracy. Placement, contact geometry and tracker bias can be absorbed into translation.

rotation_verification.note: Axes are checked modulo 24 cube symmetries; printed face identity is not inferred. Mesh axes are assumed to represent physical cube faces.

reference_geometry: measured finger-link plane; no horizontal/table assumption
